content: Prisma ORM 7 requires explicit 'output' in the generator client block (e.g. generator client { provider = "prisma-client" output = "../src/generated/prisma" }); the client must then be imported from that generated path (e.g. './generated/prisma/client'), not from bare '@prisma/client'. All consumers (app code, better-auth adapter) must import from the same generated path.
